next.reason: 1985 base text: 'Parentheses may appear only in balanced pairs' delimiting subscripts, reference modifiers, arithmetic expressions or conditions (the pseudo-text exception came only with amendment X3.23b-1993). §2023:8.3.5 SR4 reads 'Except in pseudo-text, parentheses may appear only in balanced pairs' and adds function or method argument lists and boolean expressions. The rule is looser: unbalanced parentheses in pseudo-text and the new delimited constructs are accepted. Its picture exception restates §1985:IV.4.2.1 SR9. §2023:8.8.2 SR3 restates the balance requirement for expressions ('one-to-one correspondence between left and right parentheses'). The refusal stays at compile time, with no exception condition.
